title: yes we can — Quite, 4K for Windows
author: Quite, PRISM
notes: Chaos Constructions 2009, 4K intro, first place: raymarched in HLSL pixel shaders on one pre-transformed triangle, through a float16 render target, its music by 4klang through waveOut; compiled for SSE, packed by Crinkler. MIRAGE-WIN32 makes d3d9.dll and d3dx9_37.dll in JavaScript; PRISM's d3d9.js translates the HLSL to GLSL ES and draws it with WebGL2.
